To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
SDN, NF, NFV, cloud and fog computing, network hypervisor, and containers are essential technologies for the implementation of 5G networks and network slicing.

the 5G network is the future network that will be capable to support next generations of vertical applications with different requirements and the industry is embracing SDN, NFVs, MEC, containers and network hypervisors to realize this vision.
5G network is expected to be softwarized using SDN and virtualized using NFV.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a comprehensive and updated survey of 5G slicing using SDN/NFV.
a thorough review of 5G softwarization and network slicing technologies and their practical implementation and deployment.
the state of the art in 5G slicing using SDN, NFVs, MEC, and cloud/Fog computing.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
network softwarization is an enabler of 5G networks and the future of networking.
5G networks will be a network of networks where each network will be dedicated for a specific type of service.
the network slicing using SD-N and NFV in the 5G network is a complex and challenging task.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
network slicing is a promising approach to provide the required flexibility and scalability in 5G to support a wide range of services.
the 5G network architecture is moving towards a flexible and programmable network infrastructure with the help of softwarization using SDN and network function virtualization.
5G network slice is a logical network that is created to support the requirements of a service or a group of services.
The main takeaway from our work is that

5G network slices will be the key enabler to support different services with different requirements and the adoption of SDNs and NFVs will be the key for the successful realization of network slicing.
the 5G networks will not only be software defined and virtualized, they will be also sliced into multiple logical networks with different service requirements and characteristics.

the 5G networks can only be achieved if network softwarization is combined with network slicing to provide an efficient and flexible solution to meet the diverse requirements of different types of services in 5G.
